definitions.explanation: The network of vessels visible on a leaf that carries water and nutrients between the stem and the leaf tissue.

examples.japanese: ⟦{葉|は}→葉：02241_ha⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{細|こま}かい→細かい：01245_komakai⟧{葉脈|ようみゃく}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{見|み}える→見える：01165_mieru⟧。
examples.english: Fine leaf veins are visible on the leaf.

examples.japanese: {葉脈|ようみゃく}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{模様|もよう}→模様：03635_moyou⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{美|うつく}しい→美しい：01121_utsukushii⟧。
examples.english: The pattern of the leaf veins is beautiful.

examples.japanese: ⟦{顕微鏡|けんびきょう}→顕微鏡：05482_kenbikyou⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{植物|しょくぶつ}→植物：03248_shokubutsu⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{葉脈|ようみゃく}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{構造|こうぞう}→構造：02730_kouzou⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{観察|かんさつ}した→観察する：21989_kansatsusuru⟧。
examples.english: I observed the structure of plant leaf veins under a microscope.

notes:
Composed of ⟦{葉|は}→葉：02241_ha⟧ (leaf) + ⟦{脈|みゃく}→脈：05247_myaku⟧ (vein).

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- ⟦{細|こま}かい→細かい：01245_komakai⟧{葉脈|ようみゃく}: fine veins
- {葉脈|ようみゃく}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{走|はし}る→走る：00519_hashiru⟧: veins run (across a leaf)
- {葉脈|ようみゃく}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{模様|もよう}→模様：03635_moyou⟧: pattern of leaf veins

USAGE:
Unlike ⟦{鉱脈|こうみゃく}→鉱脈：28771_koumyaku⟧ (ore vein) or ⟦{血管|けっかん}→血管：02742_kekkan⟧ (blood vessel), {葉脈|ようみゃく} refers strictly to the vascular pattern of plant leaves and is largely a botanical term.
